description: A chronic sleep disorder characterized by overwhelming daytime drowsiness and sudden attacks of sleep.
causes: Loss of the chemical hypocretin in the brain.
complications: Physical harm from sleep attacks and social challenges.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A kidney disorder that causes your body to pass too much protein in your urine.
causes: Damage to the clusters of small blood vessels in your kidneys that filter waste and excess water from your blood.
symptoms: Severe swelling (edema), particularly around your eyes and in your ankles and feet
Weight gain due to fluid retention
prevention: Treating underlying conditions that can cause it, like diabetes.
treatment_action: Medications to treat the underlying cause and manage symptoms (diuretics, blood pressure meds).
complications: Blood clots, high cholesterol, and kidney failure.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A genetic disorder that causes tumors to form on nerve tissue.
symptoms: Flat, light brown spots on the skin (cafe au lait spots)
Freckling in the armpits or groin area
Soft bumps on or under the skin (neurofibromas)
prevention: Genetic counseling for those with a family history.
complications: Neurological problems, vision/hearing loss, and severe pain.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A very contagious virus that causes vomiting and diarrhea.
causes: Contact with an infected person or contaminated food/water.
prevention: Wash hands thoroughly and practice good food hygiene.
treatment_action: Drinking plenty of fluids to prevent dehydration.
